messages:
Aisha Patel: Morning — quick ops pulse for Pinegrove Labs private deployment. Onboarding kickoff. Need final answers on: network peering & route table (CIDR overlap?), IAM roles for the service account, KMS key access + rotation window, CloudTrail/Splunk ingestion location, and any renewal risk flags from finance. Can we confirm blockers before Thursday?

Liam Chen: Peering request accepted. Pinegrove VPC CIDR is 10.20.0.0/16 — no overlap with our infra. Found an egress NAT rule mismatch; will update route table by EOD. Do we have the customer's preferred subnet mask?@Aisha Patel

Aisha Patel: They asked for /20 for app subnets. Keep SGs tight — only 6443 and 443. We'll need port 22 open to our jumpbox during cutover Tue 03:00-06:00 PST.

Liam Chen: noted. I'll post the exact route change once applied. Running this now: 
```bash
# add peering route to Pinegrove
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-abc123 --destination-cidr-block 10.20.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-xyz
```

Sofia Martinez: KMS update: created a CMK and granted principal 'redwood-private@pinegrove' Encrypt/Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey to the VM role. Rotation is 90 days by default. Customer requested 30-day rotation (compliance). We should open an exception request to legal if we can't meet that. CloudTrail will deliver to their S3 bucket s3://pinegrove-logs — policy applied.

Matt R.: Heads up — finance marked renewal as 'moderate risk' (renewal convo in ~6 weeks). Recommend scheduling a playbook review with PM + Solutions next week. Also capture enablement: Pinegrove wants an ops runbook + a 45-min cutover dry run prior to go-live.

infra-bot: ticket CS-91234 created for 'Pinegrove KMS exception request' — assigned to @Sofia Martinez, @Aisha Patel.

Aisha Patel: Thanks. Next steps: Liam to confirm route update here, Sofia to file the exception, Matt to set renewal sync. I'll log minutes in the onboarding doc and loop in support. Anything else?

Sofia Martinez: One more item — audit retention: customer requires 7 years of audit logs. Our default is 1 year. Need confirmation on S3 lifecycle -> Glacier plan and a cost estimate. I'll prepare a quick estimate and post tomorrow.

Liam Chen: Route change applied — rtb-abc123 now routes 10.20.0.0/16 via pcx-xyz. Verified connectivity from our jumpbox to a customer app instance. :white_check_mark:

Aisha Patel: Awesome — closing current blockers. I'll schedule renewal review + dry run. Thanks team :pray:
